_comment: Player portraits for the homepage 'Back in the Pool' rail, keyed by player name exactly as it appears in keepers.json (drop the † marker). Players without an entry fall back to their initials, so this only needs the current keeper class. Images are self-hosted in assets/images/players/ — downscaled to 96px wide from Yahoo's nfl_cutout PNGs, which are ~2MB each at source and must not be hotlinked. To add one: find the URL on the player's page at sports.yahoo.com/nfl/players/<id>/ (grep the HTML for 'nfl_cutout'), then downscale before committing. The draft-recap skill keeps its own copy of the source URLs at .claude/skills/lls-draft-recap/data/portraits-<year>.json.
